description: This file defines the abstract class 'ChannelOwner' which manages communication channels, event subscriptions, and API call instrumentation within the Playwright core library. It includes methods for managing event listeners, creating proxy channels, wrapping API calls with tracing and error handling, and disposing of objects.

classes.name: ChannelOwner
classes.description: An abstract class managing a communication channel, event subscriptions, and API call instrumentation within the Playwright core library.

methods.name: _setEventToSubscriptionMapping
methods.description: Sets the mapping between event names and subscription protocol events.

methods.name: _updateSubscription
methods.description: Updates the subscription status for a given event.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'on' method to manage subscriptions when event listeners are added.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'addListener' method to manage subscriptions.

methods.name: prependListener
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'prependListener' method to manage subscriptions.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'off' method to manage subscriptions.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'removeListener' method to manage subscriptions.

methods.name: _adopt
methods.description: Adopts a child ChannelOwner, updating parent-child relationships.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the object, cleaning up references and disposing children.

methods.name: _debugScopeState
methods.description: Returns debug information about the object and its children.

methods.name: _validatorToWireContext
methods.description: Creates a ValidatorContext for API validation.

methods.name: _createChannel
methods.description: Creates a proxy channel with validation and instrumentation.

methods.name: _wrapApiCall
methods.description: Wraps API calls with tracing, error handling, and logging.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Custom JSON serialization to prevent issues with object printing.
